data.name: Katleen
data.gender_notes: Katleen is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name Katherine, meaning pure or clear. The name became popular in the Middle Ages due to the veneration of Saint Catherine of Alexandria, a Christian martyr. Katherine is the feminine form of the Greek name Katharos, meaning pure or clean. The name Katleen carries the meaning “Pure, Clear” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Katleen usually hope their child will grow to embody pure, clear and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Katleen belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Pure, Clear.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Katleen total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_hebrew.name: קאטלין
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם קאטלין נגזר מהשם היווני Αικατερίνη, שפירושו טהורה, ברורה. השם ק مرتبط עם המילה העברית קתרוס, שפירושו טהרה. השם קאטלין משמש כנראה כגרסה שונה של השם קתרינה, הנושא משמעות של טהרה וברוריות.

in_greek.name: Κατλέην
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Κατλέην είναι πιθανόν μια παραλλαγή του ονόματος Αικατερίνη, που σημαίνει καθαρή, αγνή. Η λέξη Αικατερίνη προέρχεται από το αιγύπτιο όνομα Hecaterine, που σχετίζεται με τη θεά Αικατερίνη. Στην παράδοση Χριστιανική, το όνομα αυτό συνδέεται με την έννοια της καθαρότητας και της αρετής.

in_latin.name: Katleen
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Katleen derivatur ex nomine Graeco Αικατερίνη, quod significat pura, clara. In traditione Christiana, nomen hoc refertur ad virtutem et puritatem. Est variatio nominis Catherina, quod nomen est communiter in usu apud Christianos.

in_english.name: Katleen
in_english.long_meaning: The name Katleen is a variant of Catherine, which originates from the Greek name Αικατερίνη (Aikaterine), meaning 'pure, clear, or bright.' It is associated with the concept of purity and clarity. The name Catherine is often linked to Saint Catherine of Alexandria, a 4th-century martyr and saint in the Christian tradition. The name Katleen carries a rich spiritual significance, symbolizing the virtues of purity, faith, and devotion. Historically, the name has been popularized across various Christian cultures, representing a strong and enduring legacy.

data.spiritual_significance: Katleen is a name that carries a profound spiritual significance. Its very origin in ancient Greek philosophies speaks of purity and clarity; a reflection of the inner spirit striving for enlightenment and a pure heart. The name Katleen evolved in the Christian faith, becoming a symbol of strength, faith, and endurance, as represented by Saint Catherine herself, who is renowned for her martyrdom and unwavering faith. The name Katleen continues to be a reminder of the spiritual ideals of purity, strength, and faith.
